mutations.contract_domain: Diagnostic New over all int limits, arbitrary Go strings and caller-owned causes on supported 32-bit and 64-bit architectures
mutations.reason: The <=0 to <0 replacement differs only when maxBytes is zero. Empty strings return empty through the following length comparison; nonempty strings are sliced to [:0], which is valid UTF-8 and needs no trimming. Both paths feed strings.Clone("") into the same Error constructor and copy the same outer cause slice. Exact display bytes, errors.Is/As and Unwrap cause identity and slice ownership, input immutability and absence of retained message backing are unchanged. Negative and positive limits are identical. This proof includes malformed UTF-8 and does not assume the narrower static ASCII current callers. Independently source-reviewed by /root/schema_repair on 2026-10-14; expires 2026-11-14 or earlier material change to diagnostic helper, Clone, UTF-8 behavior, cause construction, caller contract, Go toolchain or verifier inputs. No deep-cause copying, redaction, erasure or total-time guarantee is inferred; every other non-killed mutant remains fatal.
